status.notReady: Not ready — finish environment setup to start

setup.title: Set up your environment
setup.intro: Gen Asset Studio needs Codex CLI and a ChatGPT account to generate images. Finish the steps below before you start — the app installs everything; you only sign in and grant permission when asked.

perm.title: Check permissions
perm.desc: Checks whether the app runs as Administrator.

codex.title: Install Codex CLI
codex.desc: Downloads the pinned Codex CLI into the app folder and verifies the checksum. No Node, Python or ffmpeg needed.

path.title: Add to PATH
path.desc: Adds Codex to the user PATH. No admin rights needed.

longPath.title: Enable long paths
longPath.desc: Allows paths longer than 260 characters for deep asset folders. Needs Administrator.

login.title: Sign in to Codex
login.desc: Sign in to Codex with your ChatGPT account.

quota.title: Check quota + test generation
quota.desc: Reads your quota and generates one small test image to confirm image generation works.

workspace.title: Choose a workspace
workspace.desc: Create a new workspace or open an existing folder. Each subfolder groups projects.

perm.admin: Running as Administrator — steps that need it run automatically.
perm.user: Running as a standard user — you will be asked when a step needs admin rights.

codex.checking: Looking for an installed Codex CLI…

path.ask: Add Codex to your user PATH to run codex from a terminal. The app does not need this — you can skip it.
path.skipped: Skipped — the app still uses its own Codex path.

longPath.needAdmin: Long paths are off. Enabling them needs Administrator rights.
longPath.waitingUac: Waiting for you to confirm UAC…
longPath.skipped: Skipped — paths longer than 260 characters may fail on export.

login.signedOut: Not signed in. Sign in to Codex with your ChatGPT account.
login.waiting: Waiting for the browser — come back once you have signed in.

workspace.choose: Create a new workspace or open an existing folder. Each subfolder groups projects.

testGen.hint: Optional — uses a little quota. You can skip it.

workspace.newDesc: Pick or create an empty folder
workspace.openDesc: Pick a folder used as a workspace

uac.title: Administrator rights needed
uac.body: The “Enable long paths” step changes a system registry key (LongPathsEnabled). Windows will show a UAC prompt to confirm.
uac.tip: Run the app with “Run as administrator” to skip these confirmations.

workspace.title: All projects
workspace.subtitle: No projects in this workspace yet
workspace.emptyDesc: Create a project to import a PNG set, lock a style, then regenerate it with Codex.

update.warn: A newer version may not be compatible with the app yet. The current version is kept so you can go back.

account.notSignedInDesc: Sign in with your ChatGPT account to generate images.
account.waiting: Waiting for sign-in in your browser…

fix.title: Ask Codex to fix this
fix.analyzing: Codex is reading the log and finding the cause…
fix.applied: Codex applied the fix. Press Try again to re-run the step.
fix.tip: Codex only changes the app folder and the app’s Codex config. System changes ask for permission separately. If Codex CLI itself is not installed, only Retry and Export log are available.
fix.unavailable: Codex CLI is not installed or not signed in — only Retry and Export log are available.
